infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RailIo uses the camera for AI-powered indoor station navigation and visual AR guidance.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: RailIo uses device motion sensors for step tracking, dead reckoning, and directional heading during indoor navigation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RailIo uses your location to track movement, distance, train speed, and arrival ETA during live navigation.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RailIo uses your location to provide uninterrupted live train progress and arrival alerts.
